#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Generate a bold, high-energy promotional poster for Web Summit Lisbon 2026.
Portrait orientation, dark cinematic background with electric accents.
"""

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont, ImageFilter
import math, random

# ── Canvas ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
W, H = 1200, 1800
img = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), "#05070A")
draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

# ── Helpers ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
def get_font(family, size, weight="Regular"):
    """Return a truetype font or fallback to default."""
    try:
        # Try common system paths
        paths = [
            f"/usr/share/fonts/truetype/noto/NotoSansCJK-{weight}.ttc",
            f"/usr/share/fonts/opentype/noto/NotoSansCJK-{weight}.ttc",
            f"/usr/share/fonts/noto-cjk/NotoSansCJK-{weight}.ttc",
            "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans-Bold.ttf",
            "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/liberation/LiberationSans-Bold.ttf",
            "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/freefont/FreeSansBold.ttf",
        ]
        for p in paths:
            try:
                return ImageFont.truetype(p, size)
            except Exception:
                continue
        return ImageFont.load_default()
    except Exception:
        return ImageFont.load_default()

# Load fonts
font_title      = get_font("Noto Sans CJK", 120, "Bold")
font_subtitle   = get_font("Noto Sans CJK", 48,  "Bold")
font_date       = get_font("Noto Sans CJK", 42,  "Bold")
font_metric_big = get_font("Noto Sans CJK", 90,  "Bold")
font_metric_lbl = get_font("Noto Sans CJK", 28,  "Regular")
font_body       = get_font("Noto Sans CJK", 30,  "Regular")
font_small      = get_font("Noto Sans CJK", 24,  "Regular")
font_cta        = get_font("Noto Sans CJK", 56,  "Bold")
font_tag        = get_font("Noto Sans CJK", 36,  "Bold")
font_speaker    = get_font("Noto Sans CJK", 26,  "Regular")
font_quote      = get_font("Noto Sans CJK", 24,  "Regular")
font_eco        = get_font("Noto Sans CJK", 26,  "Regular")

# ── Background: dark gradient + abstract light trails ───────────────
# Draw a subtle radial glow from top-center
for y in range(H):
    for x in range(0, W, 4):  # step for speed
        dx = x - W // 2
        dy = y - 300
        dist = math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy)
        intensity = max(0, 1 - dist / 1400)
        r = int(5 + intensity * 15)
        g = int(7 + intensity * 25)
        b = int(15 + intensity * 55)
        draw.rectangle([x, y, x + 3, y], fill=(r, g, b))

# Abstract light trails (diagonal electric cyan/magenta streaks)
random.seed(42)
for _ in range(60):
    x1 = random.randint(-200, W)
    y1 = random.randint(0, H)
    length = random.randint(200, 800)
    angle = random.uniform(0.3, 0.8)  # shallow diagonal
    x2 = x1 + length * math.cos(angle)
    y2 = y1 + length * math.sin(angle)
    color = random.choice(["#00F0FF", "#FF00AA", "#39FF14", "#00F0FF"])
    width = random.randint(1, 3)
    draw.line([(x1, y1), (x2, y2)], fill=color, width=width)

# Soft vignette
overlay = Image.new("RGBA", (W, H), (0, 0, 0, 0))
ov_draw = ImageDraw.Draw(overlay)
for i in range(300):
    alpha = int(180 * (i / 300))
    ov_draw.rectangle([i, i, W - i, H - i], outline=(0, 0, 0, alpha))
img = Image.alpha_composite(img.convert("RGBA"), overlay).convert("RGB")
draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

# ── Geometric accent bar at top ─────────────────────────────────────
draw.rectangle([0, 0, W, 12], fill="#00F0FF")

# ── Header: Event title & dates ─────────────────────────────────────
title = "WEB SUMMIT"
sub   = "LISBON 2026"
# Slight glow behind title
for offset in range(8, 0, -2):
    alpha = 30
    glow_color = (0, 240, 255)
    draw.text((60 - offset, 80), title, font=font_title, fill=glow_color)
    draw.text((60 + offset, 80), title, font=font_title, fill=glow_color)
draw.text((60, 80), title, font=font_title, fill="#FFFFFF")
draw.text((60, 210), sub, font=font_subtitle, fill="#00F0FF")

# Date / location pill
pill_w, pill_h = 520, 70
pill_x, pill_y = 60, 310
draw.rounded_rectangle([pill_x, pill_y, pill_x + pill_w, pill_y + pill_h], radius=12, fill="#111827", outline="#00F0FF", width=2)
draw.text((pill_x + 30, pill_y + 12), "November 9 – 12, 2026  •  Lisbon, Portugal", font=font_date, fill="#FFFFFF")

# ── Urgency banner: 2-for-1 sale ────────────────────────────────────
banner_y = 440
banner_h = 220
# Magenta urgency block
draw.rectangle([0, banner_y, W, banner_y + banner_h], fill="#FF00AA")
# Diagonal stripe texture on banner
for i in range(-H, W, 40):
    draw.line([(i, banner_y), (i + 200, banner_y + banner_h)], fill="#D6008A", width=2)

# Big 50% text
draw.text((60, banner_y + 30), "2-FOR-1 TICKETS", font=get_font("", 72, "Bold"), fill="#FFFFFF")
draw.text((60, banner_y + 115), "SAVE 50% — 24 HOURS ONLY", font=get_font("", 42, "Bold"), fill="#FFFFFF")
# Right-side badge
draw.rounded_rectangle([W - 280, banner_y + 40, W - 60, banner_y + 180], radius=80, fill="#FFFFFF", outline="#00F0FF", width=4)
draw.text((W - 240, banner_y + 70), "50%", font=get_font("", 72, "Bold"), fill="#FF00AA")
draw.text((W - 240, banner_y + 145), "OFF", font=get_font("", 32, "Bold"), fill="#111827")

# ── Metrics row ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
metrics_y = 720
metrics = [
    ("70,000+", "ATTENDEES"),
    ("4 DAYS", "OF KEYNOTES & NETWORKING"),
    ("10+", "WORLD-CLASS SPEAKERS"),
    ("5", "TRACKS FOR EVERYONE"),
]
box_w = W // 4
for i, (val, lbl) in enumerate(metrics):
    x = i * box_w
    # subtle card bg
    draw.rounded_rectangle([x + 8, metrics_y, x + box_w - 8, metrics_y + 180], radius=8, fill="#0B1220", outline="#1F2937", width=1)
    # accent top line
    draw.rectangle([x + 8, metrics_y, x + box_w - 8, metrics_y + 6], fill="#00F0FF" if i % 2 == 0 else "#FF00AA")
    # value
    draw.text((x + box_w // 2, metrics_y + 40), val, font=font_metric_big, fill="#FFFFFF", anchor="mm")
    # label
    draw.text((x + box_w // 2, metrics_y + 125), lbl, font=font_metric_lbl, fill="#9CA3AF", anchor="mm")

# ── Speakers section ────────────────────────────────────────────────
spk_y = 960
draw.text((60, spk_y), "PAST HEADLINERS", font=get_font("", 40, "Bold"), fill="#00F0FF")
spk_y += 60
speakers = [
    "Sam Altman  —  CEO, OpenAI",
    "Geoffrey Hinton  —  Godfather of AI",
    "Ursula von der Leyen  —  President, EU Commission",
    "António Guterres  —  UN Secretary-General",
    "Serena Williams  —  Tennis Champion",
    "Ryan Reynolds  —  Actor & Entrepreneur",
    "Pharrell Williams  —  Artist & Entrepreneur",
    "Doug Leone  —  Sequoia Capital",
]
# Two columns
col1_x, col2_x = 60, 620
for idx, s in enumerate(speakers):
    x = col1_x if idx < 4 else col2_x
    y = spk_y + (idx % 4) * 44
    draw.text((x, y), "▸ " + s, font=font_speaker, fill="#D1D5DB")

# ── Testimonials ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
test_y = spk_y + 4 * 44 + 60
draw.text((60, test_y), "WHAT LEADERS SAY", font=get_font("", 40, "Bold"), fill="#00F0FF")
test_y += 60
quotes = [
    '"Coming to Web Summit is really an opportunity to peer\na bit into the future, connect to it, and be part of it."\n— Brad Smith, President, Microsoft',
    '"To hear from today\'s tech giants\' CTOs and CIOs — well,\nit was a pretty amazing day!"\n— Miguel Figueiredo, Siemens',
    '"Web Summit is a perfect illustration of the power\nof community."\n— Alicia Tillman, CMO, SAP',
]
for q in quotes:
    # quote card bg
    h_est = 110
    draw.rounded_rectangle([60, test_y, W - 60, test_y + h_est], radius=8, fill="#0F172A", outline="#1F2937", width=1)
    draw.text((90, test_y + 15), q, font=font_quote, fill="#9CA3AF")
    test_y += h_est + 20

# ── Ecosystem / CTA ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
cta_y = test_y + 30
draw.text((60, cta_y), "STARTUPS • INVESTORS • MEDIA • PARTNERS • ATTENDEES", font=get_font("", 28, "Bold"), fill="#FFFFFF")
cta_y += 60

# Big CTA button
draw.rounded_rectangle([60, cta_y, W - 60, cta_y + 100], radius=16, fill="#00F0FF")
draw.text((W // 2, cta_y + 50), "REGISTER NOW — LISBON AWAITS", font=font_cta, fill="#05070A", anchor="mm")

# ── Footer ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
footer_y = H - 80
draw.text((60, footer_y), "websummit.com/lisbon-2026", font=font_small, fill="#6B7280")
draw.text((W - 60, footer_y), "#WebSummit #Lisbon2026", font=font_small, fill="#6B7280", anchor="rm")

# ── Save ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
img.save("/app/output/final_poster.png", "PNG")
print("Saved /app/output/final_poster.png")

steps.message:
The promotional poster has been generated and saved to `/app/output/final_poster.png`.

### Poster Summary
- **Size:** 1200 × 1800 px (portrait)
- **Style:** Dark cinematic background (deep midnight blue/black) with electric cyan and hot magenta accents, evoking a premium tech-forward feel.
- **Key Elements:**
  - **Header:** "WEB SUMMIT LISBON 2026" anchored at the top with event dates (November 9–12, 2026) in a bold pill.
  - **Urgency Banner:** A high-contrast magenta block featuring the "2-FOR-1 TICKETS — SAVE 50% — 24 HOURS ONLY" offer, with a large "50% OFF" badge on the right for instant visual impact.
  - **Metrics Row:** Four data cards highlighting 70,000+ attendees, 4 days, 10+ world-class speakers, and 5 tracks.
  - **Past Headliners:** Two-column list of notable speakers (Sam Altman, Geoffrey Hinton, Serena Williams, etc.).
  - **Testimonials:** Quote cards from Brad Smith (Microsoft), Miguel Figueiredo (Siemens), and Alicia Tillman (SAP).
  - **CTA:** A bold electric-cyan "REGISTER NOW — LISBON AWAITS" button near the bottom.
  - **Footer:** Event URL and hashtags.

The design prioritizes the 2-for-1 ticket offer as the most visually dominant element while maintaining a clean, confident hierarchy throughout.
